t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Please take a note of the hat as this can change. Stay focussed and complete the task in a timely,focussed manner.

vb_textbox.text: There are various gnomes with different shape hats. They have different colours and some have spots. The key to the game is to try and work out which gnome type collects the most mushrooms in order to get the highest points. Memory and recall is key here.
